svg.text: Electrons and holes meet at the junction and form a depletion region.
This builds a barrier of about 0.7 V (typical silicon diode) that stops more carriers crossing.
2. Forward bias: P to +, N to −
A source above about 0.7 V overcomes the barrier: the depletion region
3. Reverse bias: P to −, N to +
Carriers are pulled away from the junction: the depletion region widens
